title: Categories
intro: Groups and categories for filtering recipes. Drag the handle to sort – categories can also move to another group. Each name exists only once (case and accents don't count).

merge_recipes.one: The recipe with "{name}" gets "{into}". Then "{name}" is deleted.
merge_recipes.other: All {count} recipes with "{name}" get "{into}". Then "{name}" is deleted.

merge_empty: "{name}" has no recipes and will be deleted.

delete_tag_used.one:
"{name}" is assigned to one recipe.

Delete category? The recipe stays as it is, only the assignment is removed.
delete_tag_used.other:
"{name}" is assigned to {count} recipes.

Delete category? The recipes stay as they are, only the assignment is removed.

delete_tag_unused: Delete category "{name}"? It isn't assigned to any recipe.

skill.title: Rezeptplaner categories
skill.intro: As of {date}. For "categories", use only these names, spelled exactly like this – they replace the skill's categories.md (save as a file and pass it with --categories when building).

copied: Category list copied – paste it into the chat with Claude.
copy_failed: Copying isn't possible here – select the text below and copy it.
course_badge_title: Quick filter tabs and courses in menus
course_hint: The course group (starter, main course, cakes …) controls the tabs in the recipe overview.
assign_courses_hint: suggestions for recipes without a course.
claude_hint: The Claude skill only knows the default categories. After making changes here, copy the list and paste it into the chat with Claude; during import, unknown categories can also be mapped or created.

delete_dialog.title: Delete group "{name}"
delete_dialog.with_tags: Delete categories too ({recipes} lose the assignment, the recipes stay)
